text:
maya: Heads-up: I submitted a compact docs PR replacing the big heatmap example with a CSV-style cost delta table and updated trace-hook usage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4201

own: Can you list which snippets to change? I can run md-lint and the snippet sandbox.

maya: Two snippets (console/examples/heatmap.md): node + python. Change param `traceid` -> `trace_key`, and note batching tradeoffs. Use relative deltas, not absolute ms.

tara: Ill update node. jen, want python?

jen: Taking python. Plan: swap to prefetch="windowed", update labels, run sandbox for p95 + avg.

own: Linter caught missing code fence languages and a broken anchor in the cost table. I'll open a tiny patch and drop it into the PR branch.

docs-bot: CI started for PR 4201 and linter patch PR 4202 8a00. Snippet sandbox queued.

maya: Please also add a one-line guidance under the table: "prefetch reduces tail latency but may increase per-token cost". Keep numbers relative.

jen: Sandbox passed locally; pushing snippet update in a few.

tara: Node snippet updated and pushed to maya's branch. Left an inline reviewer note about trace_key rename.

own: I merged the anchor fix into the branch. Waiting on CI green then we can merge.

maya: Thanks all  keeping thread pinned until merge. If CI errors, drop a quick note here.
